how.h2: Trial in their hands. A guide they keep. A follow-up that lasts.
steps: Your product, delivered at the moment of need through clinics, schools and universities. Real trial, not an impression.
A printed guide in every box, also online as a flipbook; for teens and students, a web guide. Your brand earns a useful place, not just an ad slot.
Opt-in, GDPR-compliant registration, then email, SMS, call centre and direct mail continue the conversation.
Our own platforms (Babyspace, Myparenthood, HeyMaa, Mybabywinner, Momtag, Myschoolwinner, LadiesBook) keep the audience close and roll them into the next START.
